summary: Maris-Tech Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq (MTEK/MTEKW), furnished a Form 6-K on October 20, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the launch of Uranus-Drones-V2, a compact video and AI processing platform for UAV integration. The release touts up to four UHD camera inputs, eight total camera inputs, over 30 TOPS processing, autopilot connectivity, and onboard inertial/environmental sensors supporting autonomous flight. No transaction, price, stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. The filing is a routine product announcement incorporated by reference into existing S-8 and F-3 registration statements; no risk-arb angle applies.
